verification.rev3Amendment: CONFIRMED as the minimal sound resolution of a genuine plan gap. Breakage mechanism verified independently from source (not just the worker's report): backend/tests/integration/test_migration_009_contacts_segment.py:66 stamps 'head' and :70 runs head-relative downgrade '-1' — once 010_chat_leave exists, '-1' from head executes 010's downgrade and lands on the 009 state, so the 008-state assertions at :72-73 ('contacts' not in tables, 'is_dm' not in chats_columns) fail deterministically; the rev-2 write-set contained no file that could fix it, making the wave's exit-0 suite gate (verify:backend green modulo only the 4 ingestion failures) unachievable. The fix — one functional line changing the downgrade target to the explicit revision id '008_pg_trgm_search_indexes' plus a comment — preserves the test's documented intent exactly (from a stamped head, downgrading to 008 still runs 009's own downgrade; upgrading to head re-applies 009 and 010; both 009-segment directions stay exercised) and is head-independent (future 011+ cannot break it again). Alternatives rejected correctly: leaving the test red breaks the pinned gate; skipping/deselecting the test silently weakens evidence; reverting 010 blocks the operator-approved feature; the only comparable variant (stamp '009_contacts' + keep '-1') is equal in size but leaves the step-relative fragility. Ownership legality: the 009 SEGMENT TEST is not in WS-BE-CHAT-LEAVE.forbiddenWrites (which protects the migration scripts 001-009 — untouched); adding the test to writes is the correct ALK-legal authorization for the forced deviation. Delta audit: the rev-3 edit is exactly the five stated changes — planRevision 3; the 009 test added to WS-BE writes (13 entries, no forbiddenWrites collision); the migration plannedItem's amendment sentence (with a semantics-free 'downgrade -1' -> 'downgrade one step' reword of the 010-pattern phrasing, correct since one step down from head 010 is 010's downgrade); planReview.reviewedRevision 3; the matching amendment sentence in plan.md wave-1 and the AC-BE-LEAVE row — everything else byte-identical to the approved frozen rev-2 (requirements, other writes/plannedItems, ACs, gates, budgets, planFiles all verified line-by-line).
